nav.label: Main

hero.lead: A real Chrome on your own server, which sites see as an ordinary browser. Your agents drive it over MCP or the API, and you take over from any computer for logins and 2FA. Each saved session stays in a vault on your server, encrypted with a key only your password unlocks. No usage fees.
for.label: Who it’s for
for.agents.title: Stealth browsers for your agents
for.agents.text: Claude Code, Codex or any agent drives a real Chrome over MCP or the API, and sites see an ordinary browser. When it hits a login or a 2FA code, you take over; it waits, then carries on. What you type in password fields never reaches it.
for.you.title: Session vaults for you
for.you.text: Log in once and stay logged in: your sessions wait in vaults on your server, not on your laptop, encrypted with a key your password unlocks and locked after a restart until you enter it. Open them from any computer, signing in with your password (and a 2FA code if you turn it on) or a passkey.
